title: The Road to live on /ops has seven steps with no hand check, the demo waits for the content contract and the listing for a live demo, and the template page reads in short compact rows
steps: S1: From the repo root with TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 apps/tracy-web/test/road-to-live.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/ops-quickstarts.test.mjs
S2: Run tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tracy-harness/tsconfig.json, then node --test packages/web/tracy-harness/test/*.test.mjs
S3: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run, and the named tests.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests; tsc exits 0.

S1: the road has seven steps release, install-file, contract, demo, listing, published, polish and no check step or manual state; demo is blocked by contract while the release has no contract of its own, listing is blocked by demo while no demo is live and no listing is saved; a live demo and a saved listing stay done; a shown listing with nothing to polish has every step done.

S2: Road to live reads seven steps, 7/7 and Live when published, every CMS group starts collapsed; the Joomla contract step is one prompt with no pinned version; why and fact lines fit 90 characters and /ops steps are at most three; a failed demo is one row with Failed, the versions and Retry install; Install demo and Retry install are off while the demo waits for the contract; the Quickstart settings contract row is one line with None and a step 3 link; with no demo the listing card shows one muted line and no form; Publish draws no Needs line and is not drawn without a listing.
evidence: 11/10/2026, reviewing the template page on dev after #1165: the hand check step never closed, the page was too long to see where to start, and a demo or listing made before the contract was redone after the contract cut a new version.
fence: The road module and the quickstarts door over a real Postgres, and the harness components rendered in node:test. Not exercised: a real demo install, Save listing or Publish in a browser, or the page on cowork.tracy.site.
